title: Villume Website UI Design Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #1763: Virtual Gallery Editor UI Revamp
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Virtual Gallery Editor UI revamp. Based on:

  • docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-05-editor-ui-revamp/brief.md
  • docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-05-editor-ui-revamp/prd.md

Task Order #9165

Scope

Refresh the visible Virtual Gallery Editor interface while preserving the current editor model (left-side inspector/sidebar plus full canvas workspace). Modernize the surrounding interface with Villume's current design tokens (var(--background), var(--card), var(--surface-tint), var(--border), var(--foreground), var(--muted-foreground), var(--primary), var(--destructive), var(--halo)), Geist typography, restrained panels, clean borders, compact controls, and consistent interactive states.

  1. Editor shell and sidebar — surface, spacing, scroll behavior, hierarchy.
  2. Main toolbar — save, publish/unpublish, help, preview, undo, redo, delete.
  3. Gallery title area — input styling, focus, disabled/read-only states.
  4. Tab navigation — Artworks, Objects, Text, Settings, Publish.
  5. Canvas and preview controls — canvas surroundings and mobile/tablet/desktop controls.
  6. Visible tab panels — existing controls adopt the refreshed visual system.
  7. Editor dialogs — delete gallery, frame editor, save frame, delete frame, close frame editor, field of view, and other visible editor-owned dialogs, following the project PrimeNG dialog ownership rule (shared shell under src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/, feature-specific body styles stay with the owning component).
  8. Loading, disabled, hover, active, empty, and error states must remain readable and consistent.
  9. Responsive checks — desktop and narrower viewports must not overlap or clip key controls.

Out of Scope

  • No new editing features or workflow redesign.
  • No changes to save, publish, preview, undo, redo, rename, delete, asset, object, text, settings, or sharing logic.
  • No backend/API/schema/auth changes.
  • No replacement of the left-sidebar plus canvas model.
  • Public viewer/gallery visitor pages are untouched.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Editor preserves the left-sidebar plus canvas workspace model.
  • Sidebar uses Villume's newer token-based surfaces, borders, typography, and spacing.
  • Toolbar actions remain visible and functional (save, publish/unpublish, help, preview, undo, redo, delete).
  • Gallery rename/title behavior is unchanged.
  • Artworks, Objects, Text, Settings, and Publish tabs remain available with a clear active state.
  • All visible tab panels use the refreshed visual language.
  • Canvas remains the dominant workspace; mobile/tablet/desktop preview controls remain available.
  • Loading, disabled/blocked, empty, and error states are readable.
  • Editor dialogs use modernized styling, scoped to unique editor wrapper classes; shared PrimeNG shell work stays under src/assets/scss/primeNg/dialog/.
  • No backend API or data model changes introduced.
  • Required build verification passes (pnpm build:dev:ssr).
  • Responsive review finds no major overlap or clipped-control issues.

RESULT
